# Binance fixtures

Hand-written from Binance's public API documentation for `GET /api/v3/ticker/24hr`
(https://developers.binance.com/docs/binance-spot-api-docs/rest-api/market-data-endpoints),
because api.binance.com is not reachable from the development network (ADR 0006).
Values are illustrative; the shape and field types (all numbers as strings) follow the docs.
